limitations: Badges were reviewed in per-chapter contact sheets and in enlarged crops of the regions the emblem edit changed (up to six per frame); small background badges were checked at contact-sheet scale.
The first-pass frames drew several badges as the kanji 夫 or 未; they were not shipped. ch14-intro-cut05 also had its background torii corrected to Yasukuni’s plain steel Shinmei form in the same edit.
ch17-victory-cut03 and cut04 were edited again after the emblem pass to correct the view from Wakakusa-yama; their badges were re-reviewed in enlarged before/after crops.
